newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria tenders for 100,000 tonnes wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria tenders for 100,000 tonnes wheat - trade.

text.p: Algeria on Monday launched a snap tender for the purchase of a total of 100,000 tonnes of French and/or U.S. and/or Argentine soft wheat for shipment in the second half of December, European traders said.
It invited traders to submit bids on Monday with results expected at the earliest later in the day, they said.
Last week Algeria bought at least 75,000 tonnes of wheat, including two cargoes of Argentine wheat and one of French wheat.
Traders linked the new tender to the recent sale of U.S and French soft wheat to Egypt at prices traders described as "very low".
"The sale to Egypt was made at a very low price that sparked new interest from Algeria," said one trader.
On Saturday Egypt bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat, 150,000 tonnes of French soft red wheat and 50,000 tonnes of Australian soft white wheat.
Egypt bought the French soft wheat at prices ranging from $146.50 to $147 per tonne fob.
This was some $10 below the prices fetched by the last week's sale of French wheat to Algeria, they said.
